feature_commits.feature: Checked native and public multivariate prime-field GCD/LCM
Native objective derivatives, local stationary certification and portable replay
PDE binding compile repair, exact hidden-pole refusal assertions and GCD examples

implemented: Complete monic GF(p) multivariate GCD/LCM using a fully checked principal-ideal intersection and an independent original-coefficient identity check; common-divisor or product checks alone do not establish greatestness.

Native Poly/PurePoly and module gcd/lcm dispatch preserves ordered typed generators, characteristic, monic normalization, zero/scalar cases and lifting policy. No rational or univariate retry follows multivariate entry.

ObjectiveProblem and typed Session/NDJSON requests expose original-source value/gradient/Hessian enclosures and independently checked unique nonsingular stationary points, with local minimum/maximum/saddle/unclassified results.

Canonical stationary witness export/replay binds the receiver objective, exact typed coordinate order, requested box and context. Stored classifications are neither serialized nor trusted. The existing bounded chunk protocol has a distinct stationary artifact kind.
Protected verifier resources and complete output admission precede stationary-handle publication; cancellation and refused work retain cumulative accounting.

The existing PDE argument extractor now converts PyClassGuardError to PyErr before collecting PyResult, repairing the preexisting native bridge compile error. Direct argument probes preserve success, ValueError and TypeError behavior.

gcd_lcm.additional_limits: Auxiliary elimination, intermediate degrees, term growth and complete-intersection limits can refuse otherwise admitted input shapes. No partial result is accepted.
gcd_lcm.evidence: Immutable in-process composition receipts; no new portable proof-kernel family or compatibility-profile claim.

objectives.claim: A unique nonsingular stationary point within the requested box with sufficient local Hessian classification. No global optimum or exhaustive stationary enumeration is asserted.
